drawing: Each region already includes sourceRect placement within the original 55x43 canvas. Draw at pointerPosition-hotspot*scale. Do not apply sourceRect a second time. Use nearest sampling.

documentation.limitation: Default table documentation targets YR; selected ranges are checked against original RA2 pixels. Source SHP/PAL contain no action names, animation clock or click-hotspot table.
documentation.timing: Interval 4 is documented. Nominal 60 Hz conversion (4/60 seconds) is an explicit inferred render-clock choice, not a timing value encoded in the original SHP.
documentation.hotspots: Documented full-canvas alignment: Left/Top=0, Center/Middle=floor(size/2), Right/Bottom=size-1. SHP/PAL do not encode click hotspots.

pixelPolicy: Original palette indices, 6-bit PAL<<2 colors, canvas, frame crop and transparency retained. No redrawn pointer, synthesized invalid sign, recoloring or resampling.
